name: fg-f2-armed
why: F2 armed (menu only): fg::inputs resolved slGetNewFrameToken/slSetConstants/slSetTagForFrame/slDLSSGGetState (the one-shot '[fg] inputs: ready=1' line), DLSS-G is loaded but still eOff (options/state read back mode=0, status=0x0), the SL proxy still owns the game chain and the panel's Present hook still fires. dwell_s=30 because the F1 failure modes (cmdQ.pacer, device removed) landed ~2 s after the chain existed. Every require is a menu-time line on purpose: an L1 run never enters a world, so 'frame=' with a valid tag, '[eval]' and 'arg10' must not be asserted here.
requires: \[fg\] streamline: DLSS_G options set=0 state=0 mode=0\b
